current_date: Page last reviewed 11 February 2026 (no adoption date)
current_evidence: The cambridge.gov.uk URL 302-redirects to the GCSP page. The GCSP checklists index (last reviewed 30 July 2026) lists this page under Cambridge City Council. It also says a new joint Local Validation Checklist was consulted on (closed 28 July) and is being reviewed, but it has not yet taken effect.

issues.detail: The cambridge.gov.uk checklist URLs used for the workbook link and many sources (full, householder, LBC, reserved matters, advertisement, LDC) now redirect to greatercambridgeplanning.org. The workbook should cite the GCSP URLs.

Grokbot mixed South Cambridgeshire District Council checklists into Cambridge City's data. The GCSP pages 'householder-planning-application', 'full-planning-permission', 'outline-planning-permission', 'approval-of-reserved-matters', 'listed-building-consent', 'remove-or-variation-of-a-condition-section-73' and 'advertisement-consent' are SCDC checklists. Rows sourced from them include Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal, Self-build / custom build ('Developments of 9 or fewer homes... 5% M4(2)'), Fire Statement, Cycle parking, and the s73 rows. These are South Cambs requirements, not Cambridge City ones.
issues.evidence: GCSP index lists those URLs under 'South Cambridgeshire District Council checklists'

issues.detail: Several Cambridge City full-planning requirements are missing. Specialist housing statement (all specialist housing proposals). Student housing statement (all student housing). Accessible homes statement (all housing; wheelchair statement for affordable schemes of 20+). Traffic management plan (non-householder development without a CMP). BREEAM pre-assessment (all new non-residential). Energy and carbon reduction statement (all new development other than householder). Public art strategy (major residential; 1,000 sq m+ or 0.5ha+). Community facilities statement. For householder, the Home energy questionnaire (works to existing homes needing permission) is missing.
issues.evidence: GCSP Cambridge full planning checklist items 25-28, 46-48, 50-51, 53

issues.detail: Design and Access Statement is listed under Householder, but its trigger is major development, CA/WHS thresholds or LBC. Outline rows are sourced from the reserved-matters checklists. Rows marked 'INFERRED... placed under Full planning' (36 rows) are guesses, e.g. Tall buildings / Wind microclimate assessment, whose excerpt actually describes design masterplans.

Many trigger excerpts are garbled or describe a different requirement. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' under Householder and Full is actually Arboricultural Method Statement text. 'Character / Conservation area appraisal reference' is a references list running into the noise or planning statement text. 'Noise Impact Assessment' gives only a list of WHO/IEMA guidance titles. 'Waste / Refuse' gives BNG text. 'Crime prevention / Secured by Design' is a student tenancy fragment.
issues.evidence: e.g. Householder 'Schedule of works (listed building)': 'Applicants will be required to submit an Arboricultural Method Statement in accordance with BS 5837...'

issues.detail: The tab_items under 'Submission rules' are page boilerplate, not requirements: Planning Portal guidance PDF sizes, 'Was this page helpful?', the 8-week determination period, and notice-to-owners text repeated across checklists. National drawing-standard items (site and elevation scales) are also recorded as local items.
issues.evidence: 'CLP Policy 30 ... SPD 2020 [PDF, 5.5MB] ... Was this page helpful?'

issues.detail: No list date is recorded. The GCSP pages give 'last reviewed' dates (full planning: 11 Feb 2026) but no adoption date. The workbook should also note that a new joint GCSP Local Validation Checklist is pending after consultation.
issues.evidence: Index: 'We are now reviewing the comments'

summary: The content is broadly drawn from the right GCSP checklists, but the link redirects and the data mixes in South Cambridgeshire checklists. Several Cambridge-specific requirements are missing (energy and carbon statement, BREEAM, student and specialist housing, public art, home energy questionnaire), and many triggers are garbled. A new joint GCSP list is pending.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
